specification.source: SQLite Data Recovery Specification, Test Assertions, and Test Cases, NIST/DHS CFTT, Version 1.0, April 2021

core_requirements.SFT-CR-01: The tool shall not modify the files being analyzed.
core_requirements.SFT-CR-02: The tool shall report the database configuration parameters pertinent to data recovery.
core_requirements.SFT-CR-03: The tool shall report the schema structure of the database tables.
core_requirements.SFT-CR-04: The tool shall report the data content of all recovered rows of any table in the database.
core_requirements.SFT-CR-05: The tool shall report the source for all recovered data elements.

scope_note: An internal run of the published CFTT methodology. VERAQIS is not NIST certified, approved, validated or compliant, and has not been submitted to the programme. Competitor entries are anomaly summaries from published reports on versions tested 2021-2023, not a re-test.

competitors.version_warning: Published CFTT reports describe the specific historical versions tested. They do not establish the behavior of current vendor releases. Every statement below is bound to the product version and report date it appears under, and may not be generalised to the vendor.

extraction_method.what_was_taken: The Results Summary anomaly list of each report, quoted verbatim from the locally downloaded PDF.
extraction_method.what_was_not_taken: The per-test-case detail grid (Table 2 in each report) is a two-dimensional layout of test case x journal mode with 'As Expected' / 'Not As Expected' / 'NA' cells. Text extraction interleaves its rows and columns, and a transcription made from that would risk attributing a result to the wrong cell. It was therefore NOT transcribed.
extraction_method.consequence: Assertion-level competitor rows below are derived from the anomaly summaries, which are the reports' own authoritative statements of where a tool deviated. Where a report is silent about an assertion, the value is NOT_ADDRESSED_BY_REPORT — never DOES_NOT_SUPPORT.
extraction_method.limitation: A competitor may have a Not-As-Expected cell in the detail grid that its summary did not call out. The comparison is therefore conservative towards competitors.

vendors.verbatim_summary: Belkasoft Evidence Center X v1.17.12873 was tested for its ability to report recovered SQLite database information. Except for the following anomalies, the tool was able to report and recover all supported data objects completely and accurately.
verbatim_anomalies: SQLite header parsing: PRAGMA journal mode = PERSIST is reported as Rollbackjournal.
Recoverable Rows: Deleted and modified rows are reported but not identified as such.
Data Element Metadata Reporting (Source filename): Source filename (db, journal, wal) is not reported for deleted and modified rows.
Schema Data Reporting: Data of type float, is reported as single.
Schema Data Reporting: BLOB data is reported as type byte, no content is reported.
Recovered Data Info: File offset of recovered rows is not reported.
interpretation_notes: Deleted and modified rows are reported but not identified as such is an anomaly against SFT-AO-04/AO-05 (origin reporting) while simultaneously evidencing that recoverable rows WERE reported — so SFT-CA-11/CA-12 are recorded as supported.
The PERSIST-reported-as-Rollbackjournal anomaly is grouped by the report under header parsing, which is where SFT-CA-04/CA-05 live.

vendors.verbatim_summary: Cellebrite Physical Analyzer v7.58.0.66 was tested for its ability to report recovered SQLite database information. Except for the following anomalies, the tool was able to report and recover all supported data objects completely and accurately.
verbatim_anomalies: SQLite Header Parsing: PRAGMA journal mode = WAL, PERSIST, and OFF are not reported.
SQLite Header Parsing: PRAGMA encoding = UTF8, UTF16LE, UTF16BE are not reported.
SQLite Header Parsing: PRAGMA page_size = 1024, 4096, 8192 are not reported.
SQLite Header Parsing: PRAGMA Foreign keys = OFF is not reported.
SQLite Schema Data Reporting: BLOB data containing pdf files are not displayed.
interpretation_notes: The four header anomalies map onto page size (CA-03), journal mode write/read version (CA-04/CA-05) and text encoding (CA-07). Foreign-keys reporting has no corresponding assertion in the specification.
Recoverable rows are not listed as an anomaly, so CA-11/CA-12 are recorded as supported.

vendors.verbatim_summary: Magnet Forensics Axiom Examine v5.5.1.26621 was tested for its ability to report recovered SQLite database information. Except for the following anomalies, the tool was able to report and recover all supported data objects completely and accurately.
verbatim_anomalies: Axiom Examine v5.5.1.26621 is designed exclusively as an SQLite Viewer. Therefore, SQLite header parsing, data recovery, and other tests not supported by the tool are marked as Not Applicable (NA).
interpretation_notes: This is not a weak result. The tested component is an SQLite Viewer, and the report says so: header parsing and data recovery were marked Not Applicable because the tool does not claim them. Comparing VERAQis against it on those assertions would be comparing against a product with a different purpose.
The AXIOM suite as a whole is not what was tested here. Nothing in this row may be generalised to AXIOM.

vendors.verbatim_summary: Sanderson Forensic Browser v3.3.0 was tested for its ability to report recovered SQLite database information. Except for the following anomalies, the tool was able to report and recover all supported data objects completely and accurately.
verbatim_anomalies: SQLite header parsing: PRAGMA Foreign keys=OFF is reported as true.
SQLite schema data reporting: Binary Large Object (BLOB) data containing heic and pdf graphic files are not displayed. The tool reports not an image or not a valid image.
Recovered row metadata: The tool does not specify updated records as modified.
NOTES: Header results will remain consistent when journal_mode is set to any of the following: DELETE, MEMORY, OFF, PERSIST or TRUNCATE. Sanderson reports journal mode for PERSIST and OFF as DELETE.
NOTES: Documentation states hashes are reported as MD5 while the tool only provides SHA1 hashes.
interpretation_notes: The tool does not specify updated records as modified is an anomaly against AO-04/AO-05.
The journal-mode note is recorded against CA-04/CA-05: reporting PERSIST and OFF as DELETE is a reporting deviation of the kind those assertions cover.
